fields.description: Altitude de GRISOGONO is DAMAC’s branded residential tower on Dubai Canal in Business Bay. Studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments sit alongside larger duplex layouts, with wellness facilities and shared leisure areas forming part of the development.

overview: The brochure connects the building’s design to the opal gemstone, using neutral interiors and curved outdoor edges. Its wellness offer includes treatments and water-based relaxation facilities. Their eventual operation, access and any charges should be checked alongside the apartment specification.
research.locationNote: DAMAC places Altitude on Dubai Canal in Business Bay, near its Canal Heights and Canal Crown developments. Confirm the selected unit’s orientation and access route; a canal-side address does not establish an unobstructed view from every home.
research.priceNote: The dated launch offer starts at AED 1.18 m for a studio, AED 1.93 m for one bedroom, AED 3.30 m for two, AED 6.28 m for three and AED 8.86 m for a two-bedroom duplex. These are historical guides; confirm current stock and a dated final quotation.
research.paymentNote: The original 70/30 offer has 20% at booking,50% in construction instalments and 30% at completion. Grouped rows preserve the monthly schedule. A later Bayut guide instead gives 20/55/25. The launch’s limited-time 4% DLD waiver has not been treated as a current benefit.
research.handoverNote: Bayut’s highlights and FAQ say Q1 2027, while its dedicated completion section says Q1 2028. A contractual developer date was not retrieved, so the headline remains unconfirmed.
